svg.title: New York, New Jersey, Florida and California moved furthest toward the Republican nominee, each by 9 points or more.
svg.desc: A tile map with one square per state, each holding an arrow as long as the state’s shift toward the Republican nominee from 2020 to 2024. Every arrow points the same way. The largest shifts were New York 10.5, New Jersey 10.0, Florida 9.7 and California 9.0 points; the smallest were Washington 1.0, Utah 1.1, Oklahoma 1.2 and Nebraska 1.4. The United States moved 5.9 points.
svg.text: Frame: the leader changed, from the Democratic to the Republican nominee
